description: Defines enums, structs, and function prototypes related to voting system in the game, including vote types, targets, options, and handling functions.

methods.name: G_HandleVote
methods.description: Handles a vote, expected to be called with pre-pushed arguments.

methods.name: G_AddCustomVote
methods.description: Adds a custom vote with specified templates and definitions.

methods.name: G_ParseVoteType
methods.description: Parses a string into a VoteType enum.

methods.name: G_VoteTypeString
methods.description: Returns string representation of a VoteType.

methods.name: G_ParseVoteTarget
methods.description: Parses a string into a VoteTarget enum.

methods.name: G_VoteTargetString
methods.description: Returns string representation of a VoteTarget.

methods.name: G_ParseVoteOptions
methods.description: Parses a string into a VoteOptions enum.

methods.name: G_VoteOptionsString
methods.description: Returns string representation of a VoteOptions.

methods.name: G_ParseReasonNeeded
methods.description: Parses a string into a qtrinary value indicating if a reason is needed.

methods.name: G_ReasonNeededString
methods.description: Returns string representation of a qtrinary reasonNeeded value.
